cards.ex: He's playing with fire by dating his boss's daughter.
cards.exUz: U boshlig'ining qizi bilan uchrashib, olov bilan o'ynayapti.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki riskli ish qilish; oqibatlari yomon bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan ishga aralashish.

cards.ex: After failing the exam, he's on thin ice with his parents.
cards.exUz: Imtihondan yiqilganidan keyin, u ota-onasi oldida muz ustida.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat juda nozik; xato qilish xavfi yuqori bo'lgan holat.

cards.ex: I'll take an umbrella, better safe than sorry.
cards.exUz: Men soyabon olaman, ehtiyotkorlik yaxshiroq.
cards.uzDef: Xavfni oldini olish uchun ehtiyot bo'lish kerak, keyin afsuslanishdan ko'ra.

cards.ex: Firefighters risk life and limb to save people.
cards.exUz: O't o'chiruvchilar odamlarni qutqarish uchun jonlarini xavfga qo'yadilar.
cards.uzDef: O'z hayotini yoki sog'lig'ini xavf ostiga qo'yish, juda xavfli ish qilish.

cards.ex: Driving drunk is a recipe for disaster.
cards.exUz: Mast holda mashina haydash - halokat retsepti.
cards.uzDef: Natijasi yomon bo'lishi aniq bo'lgan vaziyat yoki harakatlar kombinatsiyasi.

cards.ex: The politician skirted around the question about taxes.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi soliqlar haqidagi savoldan chetlab o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Muammoli mavzuni muhokama qilishdan qochish, unga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri murojaat qilmaslik.

cards.ex: We took a gamble and invested in the new company.
cards.exUz: Biz tavakkal qilib, yangi kompaniyaga sarmoya kiritdik.
cards.uzDef: Natijasi noma'lum bo'lgan, ammo foyda keltirishi mumkin bo'lgan xavfli ish qilish.

cards.ex: They arrived home safe and sound after the storm.
cards.exUz: Ular bo'rondan keyin uyga salomat va yaxshi yetib kelishdi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday zarar ko'rmagan holda, xavfsiz holatda.

cards.ex: Remember to look before you leap when starting a business.
cards.exUz: Biznes boshlashda o'ylab qadam bosishni unutmang.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin vaziyatni yaxshilab o'rganish kerak.

cards.ex: We need to nip this problem in the bud before it gets out of hand.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni kattalashmasdan oldin ildizidan kesishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo kattalashmasdan oldin uni yo'q qilish, oldini olish.

cards.ex: I'd err on the side of caution and check the brakes again.
cards.exUz: Men ehtiyotkor bo'lib, tormozlarni yana bir bor tekshirib ko'rardim.
cards.term: err on the side of caution
cards.uzDef: Agar noaniqlik bo'lsa, xavfni minimallashtirish uchun ehtiyot choralarini ko'rish.

cards.ex: That car accident was a close call, they were lucky to survive.
cards.exUz: Bu avtohalokat juda xavfli edi, ular omon qolganlariga omad kulib boqdi.
cards.uzDef: Katta xavfdan deyarli qutulish, juda xavfli vaziyat.

cards.ex: To be on the safe side, let's leave an hour early.
cards.exUz: Xavfsiz tomonda bo'lish uchun, bir soat oldinroq ketaylik.
cards.uzDef: Xavfni minimallashtirish maqsadida ehtiyot bo'lish.

cards.ex: We're just testing the waters before we invest a lot of money.
cards.exUz: Biz katta miqdorda pul tikishdan oldin suvni sinab ko'rmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Yangi g'oyani yoki vaziyatni xavfni minimallashtirib, ehtiyotkorlik bilan sinab ko'rish.

cards.ex: The debt is a ticking time bomb for the country's economy.
cards.exUz: Qarz mamlakat iqtisodiyoti uchun vaqt bombasi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan yomonlashadigan va natijada xavfli bo'lib qoladigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: If you drive that fast, you run the risk of getting a ticket.
cards.exUz: Agar siz juda tez haydasangiz, jarimaga tortilish xavfini o'z zimmangizga olasiz.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilish natijasida yomon oqibatlarga duchor bo'lish ehtimoli mavjudligi.

cards.ex: Always take precautions when working with chemicals.
cards.exUz: Kimyoviy moddalar bilan ishlaganda har doim ehtiyot choralarini ko'ring.
cards.uzDef: Xavfni minimallashtirish yoki oldini olish uchun choralar ko'rish.

cards.ex: We need to get the children out of harm's way during the storm.
cards.exUz: Biz bo'ron paytida bolalarni xavfdan uzoqlashtirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xavf yoki zarar yetishi mumkin bo'lgan joydan uzoqda.

cards.ex: His constant lying is a red flag in the relationship.
cards.exUz: Uning doimiy yolg'on gapirishi munosabatlarda qizil bayroqdir.
cards.uzDef: Ogohlantiruvchi belgi; muammo borligini ko'rsatuvchi narsa.

cards.ex: Don't tempt fate by driving without a seatbelt.
cards.exUz: Xavfsizlik kamarini taqmasdan mashina haydab, taqdirni sinamang.
cards.uzDef: Omadga ishonib, xavfli ish qilish; yomon narsa sodir bo'lishi mumkinligiga qaramay, xavfli ish qilish.

cards.ex: The company cut corners on safety to save money.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya pulni tejash uchun xavfsizlik bo'yicha yo'lni qisqartirdi.
cards.uzDef: Tejamkorlik maqsadida sifatga zarar yetkazadigan usulda ish qilish; xavfli qisqa yo'ldan foydalanish.

cards.ex: I hate going to the dentist, but I'll bite the bullet and go.
cards.exUz: Men tish shifokoriga borishni yomon ko'raman, lekin tishni tishga bosib boraman.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki yoqimsiz vaziyatni sabr bilan qabul qilish; unga dosh berish.

cards.ex: He's walking a tightrope trying to please both his boss and his employees.
cards.exUz: U ham xo'jayinini, ham xodimlarini rozi qilishga urinib, arg'imchoqda yuribdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda nozik va xavfli vaziyatda bo'lish; xato qilish oson bo'lgan vaziyatda harakat qilish.

cards.ex: This situation needs to be handled with care.
cards.exUz: Bu vaziyatga ehtiyotkorlik bilan yondashish kerak.
cards.uzDef: Juda ehtiyot bo'lish kerak; zarar yetkazmaslik uchun ehtiyotkorlik bilan muomala qilish.

cards.ex: Investing in that company is a safe bet.
cards.exUz: Bu kompaniyaga sarmoya kiritish - xavfsiz garov.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi natijaga olib kelishi aniq bo'lgan narsa; ishonchli tanlov.

cards.ex: You've already won once, don't push your luck.
cards.exUz: Siz allaqachon bir marta yutdingiz, omadingizni sinamang.
cards.uzDef: Omadli vaziyatdan keyin yana xavfliroq ish qilish; oqibatlari yomon bo'lishi mumkinligini bilib, riskga kirish.

cards.ex: Alarm bells are ringing about the company's financial situation.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning moliyaviy ahvoli haqida qo'ng'iroqlar chalinyapti.
cards.uzDef: Muammo borligini ko'rsatuvchi belgilarni sezish; xavotir tuyg'usi paydo bo'lishi.

cards.ex: The patient's condition was touch and go after the surgery.
cards.exUz: Operatsiyadan keyin bemorning ahvoli xavfli edi.
cards.uzDef: Natijasi noaniq bo'lgan vaziyat; ahvol yomonlashishi yoki yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: He's skating on thin ice with his boss after missing the deadline.
cards.exUz: U muddatni o'tkazib yuborganidan keyin boshlig'i bilan nozik muzda uchmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyatda bo'lish, xato qilish oson bo'lgan vaziyatda harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Allowing them to stay out late is a slippery slope, they'll want to do it every night.
cards.exUz: Ularga kechgacha qolishga ruxsat berish - sirpanchiq yo'l, ular har kecha shuni xohlashadi.
cards.uzDef: Bitta xato yoki qaror ketma-ket yomon oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyat.
